Tap to reveal · Hold to flag · Drag to pan · Pinch to zoom
Infinite Minesweeper board. Drag to pan and pinch to zoom.

Reveal every safe tile in an 8 × 8 block to earn 100 points. A number shows how many mines touch that tile, including across block edges.

Tap to reveal and long-press to flag. Tap an open number when its neighboring flags match to chord and reveal the others. Drag to explore and pinch to zoom.

Explore: no game over and fixed 10-mine blocks. Hitting a mine reveals it without flagging it and adds one to your mistakes counter.

Survival: earn an extra life every 5 cleared blocks. A mine consumes one life and is automatically flagged; without a life, it ends the run. Every block has 10 mines.

Gauntlet: Survival rules, but blocks gain one mine per ring farther from the start, from 10 up to 24 mines.

Your first reveal and its surrounding tiles are safe. Games save automatically, and best scores are stored separately for each mode.
